_what: THE FILTER AS DATA (plan 8.1f; Doug, 2026-10-19: "I want to be able to sell this filtering concept to the semantic web community ... it should also be self evident in some way and not just a UI feature", then "Card words + navigator"). Strongest by default, the rest on request; filter, don't delete. Each entry declares one measure: what it is of, how it is computed, the cut or rank that makes the default view, which views apply it (a view chooses whether to: "the UI still needs control of when to use the filter"), and the case that set it. Read by tools/meaning/salience.py; the server, the resolver, the audit and the export use that, never a constant of their own. Published as a dqv:QualityPolicy with each entry a dqv:Metric.

card_word_share.of: a word on a card (a card's anchored Hebrew or Greek word)
card_word_share.measure: the share of the word's renderings in the text that render the card's name (tools/meaning/concept_anchors.py)
card_word_share.default: share at or above the cut; and, whatever its share, the word a verse the card cites uses (plan 4.7a: the verse is the evidence)
applied_by: the card's 'Where the text speaks of it' (server)
card_word_share.case: The server's cut since the card verses were built from anchors (plan 4.7). On 2026-10-19 it hid 3,114 anchors on 1,107 cards; the audit and the resolver had been counting them (the committee's practitioner).

navigator_tie_strength.of: a tie between two records (every relation joining them)
navigator_tie_strength.measure: certainty factor x (0.35 x the relation type's weight + 1.1 x log2(1 + shared verses + 0.5 x shared chapters)); certainty factors explicit 1, implied 0.8, disputed 0.6, conjectured 0.55; a type with no weight counts 2 (app1's edgeStrength; app2/static/index.html kgnStrength)
navigator_tie_strength.default: the strongest ties around the centre, up to the rank
navigator_tie_strength.on_request: the rest, by the navigator's slider
navigator_tie_strength.case: app1's NODE_TARGET 15 x NODE_TOLERANCE 1.4 = 21 records; on a phone, the centre and six, 7 (Doug, 2026-10-02). David alone has over 200 connections (Doug on r/semanticweb, 2026-10-12: 'show the journey the text actually narrates first').

claim_certainty.measure: the certainty step (claim:certainty: explicit, implied, conjectured, disputed)
claim_certainty.default: every step, conjectured and disputed marked as such
applied_by: the navigator's tie strength (as its certainty factor)
claim_certainty.case: Measured 2026-10-19: no view hides a claim by its certainty; it lowers a tie's rank in the navigator and is marked on cards.
